definitions.explanation: Describing a large, open space with a sense of freedom.

examples.japanese: {広々|ひろびろ}とした⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I moved to a spacious room.
examples.notes: {広々|ひろびろ}とした + noun pattern

examples.japanese: {広々|ひろびろ}とした⟦{草原|そうげん}→草原：05035_sougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked across an expansive meadow.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広々|ひろびろ}としていて⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧がいい。
examples.english: This house is spacious and feels nice.
examples.notes: {広々|ひろびろ}としている = is spacious

notes:
{広々|ひろびろ} is a mimetic reduplication of ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (wide; spacious), emphasizing openness and expansiveness.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {広々|ひろびろ}とした + noun (spacious ~)
- {広々|ひろびろ}としている (is spacious)
- {広々|ひろびろ}と + verb (spaciously)

USAGE:
{広々|ひろびろ} conveys not just physical size but a feeling of openness and freedom. It often carries a positive connotation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (wide; spacious) - plain adjective
- ⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧ (vast; extensive) - formal
- {広々|ひろびろ} - emphasizes the feeling of spaciousness

OTHER REDUPLICATIVE ADJECTIVES:
- ⟦{狭々|せまぜま}→狭々：noentry⟧ (cramped - rare)
- ⟦{長々|ながなが}→長々：noentry⟧ (at great length)
